option_relations.rationale: IgG4-related rhinosinusitis with concurrent Streptococcus constellatus bacterial rhinosinusitis is a specific type of IgG4-related disease with orbital/sinus involvement and infectious rhinosinusitis with orbital complications
IgG4-related disease is a broader class containing IgG4-related disease with orbital/sinus involvement
IgG4-Related Disease (IgG4-RD) with Orbital/Sinus Involvement is equivalent to IgG4-related disease with orbital/sinus involvement
Invasive bacterial rhinosinusitis with orbital apex syndrome is a specific type of infectious rhinosinusitis with orbital complications
